# Schema reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:gen` from the Zod schemas (`engine/core/content/manifest.ts`, `engine/tools/run-file.ts`, `engine/sim/save.ts`, `engine/sim/scenario.ts`, each content kind) and `docs/reference/examples/`. Do not edit by hand: `pnpm docs:check` (part of `pnpm test`) fails when this page is out of date. -->

One section per file format. Each table lists every field: nested fields are written under their
parent (`input.steps[].frame` is a field of each item of `input.steps`; `<key>` is any key of a map).
"Required" is whether the file must give it; a field with a default may be left out. Checks beyond
the shape (a room's map must parse, a song's MML must compile) are listed in the kind's module
page. `pnpm cli validate <game>` checks every file; errors name the file and the field.

## Game manifest (`game.json`)

Names the game and its kit, the files of each content kind, the start seed and the game's entry modules.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `games/<game>/game.json`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field           | Type                  | Required | Default                      | Limits                                                 | Description                                                                                                                  |
| --------------- | --------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`            | `string`              | yes      |                              | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                         | the game's id: its folder name                                                                                               |
| `title`         | `string`              | no       |                              | not empty                                              | one line saying what the game is                                                                                             |
| `kit`           | `string`              | yes      |                              | matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                         | the kit the game is built on (a folder under `kits/`)                                                                        |
| `uses`          | `string[]`            | no       |                              | at least 1 item; items: matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | more kits whose content kinds the game also holds (e.g. a mini game's rooms); kinds only: run rules and mutants stay `kit`'s |
| `content`       | `{ <key>: string[] }` | yes      |                              | keys: matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`                   | content kind -> its files; every file under `content/` must be claimed by one kind                                           |
| `content.<key>` | `string[]`            | no       |                              | at least 1 item; items: not empty                      | file paths or globs (`*`, `?`, `**`), relative to the game folder                                                            |
| `start`         | `object`              | yes      |                              |                                                        | how a run starts                                                                                                             |
| `start.seed`    | `integer`             | yes      |                              | >= 0                                                   | the seed for the world's RNG when nothing else gives one                                                                     |
| `screen`        | `object`              | no       | `{"width":256,"height":240}` |                                                        | the game picture's size in game px (default 256x240); scaling, the touch layout and screenshots follow it                    |
| `screen.width`  | `integer`             | yes      |                              | 64 to 1920                                             | the picture width in game px                                                                                                 |
| `screen.height` | `integer`             | yes      |                              | 64 to 1920                                             | the picture height in game px                                                                                                |
| `headless`      | `string`              | yes      |                              | not empty                                              | the module that boots the game headless (`createGame`), for `run`                                                            |
| `view`          | `string`              | no       |                              | not empty                                              | the module that boots the game for drawing (`createView`), for `screenshot`; optional                                        |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/manifest.json`):

```json
{
  "id": "one-room",
  "title": "A one-room game on the top-down kit",
  "kit": "topdown",
  "content": {
    "room": ["content/rooms/*.json"],
    "song": ["content/songs/*.json"],
    "palette": ["content/palettes/*.json"],
    "sprite": ["content/sprites/*.txt"]
  },
  "start": { "seed": 1 },
  "screen": { "width": 256, "height": 240 },
  "headless": "headless.ts",
  "view": "view.ts"
}
```

## Run file (`*.run.json`)

A seeded, scripted headless run and the checks it must pass (`pnpm cli run`).

- Defined by: engine/tools
- Where: `games/<game>/runs/<name>.run.json`; replay files in `.ww-out/replays/`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                     | Type                                                                                                         | Required | Default        | Limits                              | Description                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | -------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `game`                    | `string`                                                                                                     | no       |                | not empty                           | the game folder, relative to the run file (".." for games/&lt;g>/runs/); give this or `world`                                                                       |
| `world`                   | `string`                                                                                                     | no       |                | not empty; matches `\.world\.json$` | a world scenario (*.world.json, engine/sim), relative to the run file, played instead of a game; give this or `game`                                                |
| `seed`                    | `integer`                                                                                                    | no       |                | >= 0                                | the world's seed; the manifest's start.seed (or the scenario's seed) if left out                                                                                    |
| `ticks`                   | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | 1 to 1000000                        | how many steps the run plays                                                                                                                                        |
| `input`                   | `object`                                                                                                     | no       | `{"steps":[]}` |                                     | the scripted input (ScriptedInput steps)                                                                                                                            |
| `input.steps`             | `object[]`                                                                                                   | yes      |                |                                     | each step holds its actions from its frame until the next step                                                                                                      |
| `input.steps[].frame`     | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the input frame the hold starts at                                                                                                                                  |
| `input.steps[].hold`      | `("left" \| "right" \| "up" \| "down" \| "jump" \| "attack" \| "special" \| "start" \| "select" \| "run")[]` | yes      |                |                                     | the actions held from that frame on                                                                                                                                 |
| `assertions`              | `object[]`                                                                                                   | no       | `[]`           |                                     | checks made at one tick each                                                                                                                                        |
| `assertions[].tick`       | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the tick the check is made at                                                                                                                                       |
| `assertions[].path`       | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                | not empty                           | a dotted path into the snapshot: hero.hp, entities.0.kind, entities.length                                                                                          |
| `assertions[].op`         | `"eq" \| "ne" \| "lt" \| "lte" \| "gt" \| "gte" \| "in" \| "nin" \| "contains"`                              | yes      |                |                                     | the comparison: eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, in, nin, contains                                                                                                         |
| `assertions[].value`      | `JSON`                                                                                                       | yes      |                |                                     | what the value at the path is compared with                                                                                                                         |
| `invariants`              | `object[]`                                                                                                   | no       | `[]`           |                                     | checks made at every tick, 0 included                                                                                                                               |
| `invariants[].path`       | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                | not empty                           | a dotted path into the snapshot: hero.hp, entities.0.kind, entities.length                                                                                          |
| `invariants[].op`         | `"eq" \| "ne" \| "lt" \| "lte" \| "gt" \| "gte" \| "in" \| "nin" \| "contains"`                              | yes      |                |                                     | the comparison: eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, in, nin, contains                                                                                                         |
| `invariants[].value`      | `JSON`                                                                                                       | yes      |                |                                     | what the value at the path is compared with                                                                                                                         |
| `hashEvery`               | `integer`                                                                                                    | no       | `60`           | >= 1                                | a state hash every this many ticks (tick 0 and the last tick always get one)                                                                                        |
| `disableRules`            | `string[]`                                                                                                   | no       | `[]`           | items: not empty                    | kit rules switched off for this run (ids from the kit's rule list; see `mutants`)                                                                                   |
| `guards`                  | `string[]`                                                                                                   | no       |                | items: not empty                    | the kit rules this run is meant to guard (ids from the kit's rule list); `mutants` checks these, or every rule when left out                                        |
| `orders`                  | `object[]`                                                                                                   | no       | `[]`           |                                     | recorded orders, `{ tick, ...order }` in tick order, applied before the step from their tick (world runs: engine/core orders; game runs: the game's `order` method) |
| `orders[].tick`           | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the tick the order applies at: after that tick's state, before the step from it                                                                                     |
| `orders[].id`             | `integer`                                                                                                    | no       |                | >= 1                                | the order number (required on a world run): unique, ascending within a tick                                                                                         |
| `hashes`                  | `object[]`                                                                                                   | no       |                |                                     | sync hashes the run must give, in tick order: `run` fails at the first tick whose state hash differs                                                                |
| `hashes[].tick`           | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the tick the hash was taken at                                                                                                                                      |
| `hashes[].hash`           | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                | matches `^[0-9a-f]{16}$`            | the state hash at that tick                                                                                                                                         |
| `replay`                  | `object`                                                                                                     | no       |                |                                     | only in replay files: the source run, its failing check and its hashes                                                                                              |
| `replay.source`           | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                | not empty                           | the run file that failed, relative to the replay file                                                                                                               |
| `replay.failure`          | `object`                                                                                                     | yes      |                |                                     | the first check that failed in the source run                                                                                                                       |
| `replay.failure.tick`     | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the first failing tick                                                                                                                                              |
| `replay.failure.kind`     | `"assertion" \| "invariant"`                                                                                 | yes      |                |                                     | which list the failed check is in                                                                                                                                   |
| `replay.failure.path`     | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                | not empty                           | a dotted path into the snapshot: hero.hp, entities.0.kind, entities.length                                                                                          |
| `replay.failure.op`       | `"eq" \| "ne" \| "lt" \| "lte" \| "gt" \| "gte" \| "in" \| "nin" \| "contains"`                              | yes      |                |                                     | the comparison: eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, in, nin, contains                                                                                                         |
| `replay.failure.expected` | `JSON`                                                                                                       | yes      |                |                                     | the check's value                                                                                                                                                   |
| `replay.failure.message`  | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                |                                     | why it failed, as the source run reported it                                                                                                                        |
| `replay.hashes`           | `object[]`                                                                                                   | yes      |                |                                     | the state hashes of the source run, up to the failing tick                                                                                                          |
| `replay.hashes[].tick`    | `integer`                                                                                                    | yes      |                | >= 0                                | the tick the hash was taken at                                                                                                                                      |
| `replay.hashes[].hash`    | `string`                                                                                                     | yes      |                | matches `^[0-9a-f]{16}$`            | the state hash at that tick                                                                                                                                         |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/run.json`):

```json
{
  "game": "..",
  "seed": 1,
  "ticks": 120,
  "input": {
    "steps": [
      {
        "frame": 0,
        "hold": ["right"]
      },
      {
        "frame": 60,
        "hold": []
      }
    ]
  },
  "assertions": [
    {
      "tick": 0,
      "path": "room",
      "op": "eq",
      "value": "hall"
    },
    {
      "tick": 120,
      "path": "hero.room",
      "op": "in",
      "value": ["hall", "cellar"]
    }
  ],
  "invariants": [
    {
      "path": "hero.hp",
      "op": "gte",
      "value": 0
    }
  ],
  "hashEvery": 60,
  "guards": ["doors-change-room"]
}
```

Check ops (`op` in assertions and invariants):

| Op         | Meaning                                                                           |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `eq`       | actual equals value (deep, for arrays and objects)                                |
| `ne`       | actual does not equal value                                                       |
| `lt`       | actual &lt; value (numbers)                                                       |
| `lte`      | actual &lt;= value (numbers)                                                      |
| `gt`       | actual > value (numbers)                                                          |
| `gte`      | actual >= value (numbers)                                                         |
| `in`       | actual equals one of value (an array)                                             |
| `nin`      | actual equals none of value (an array)                                            |
| `contains` | actual (an array) has an item equal to value, or actual (a string) contains value |

## World save (`saveWorld`)

The whole simulated world (Engine 0.8): seed, tick, RNG state, next entity id, every entity's components, the system names and the event log.

- Defined by: engine/sim
- Where: wherever a game keeps its saves; `saveWorld(world)` writes it, `loadWorld(json, options)` reads it
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                    | Type                                                 | Required | Default | Limits                                   | Description                                                                            |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `format`                 | `"worlds-within/world"`                              | yes      |         |                                          | always `worlds-within/world`                                                           |
| `version`                | `1`                                                  | yes      |         |                                          | the save format version                                                                |
| `seed`                   | `integer`                                            | yes      |         |                                          | the seed the world was created with                                                    |
| `tick`                   | `integer`                                            | yes      |         | >= 0                                     | ticks committed so far                                                                 |
| `nextId`                 | `integer`                                            | yes      |         | >= 1                                     | the id the next spawn returns; never below an id already used                          |
| `rng`                    | `integer`                                            | yes      |         | 1 to 4294967295                          | the world RNG's state (`Rng.state()`)                                                  |
| `components`             | `string[]`                                           | yes      |         | items: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` | the registered component kinds, sorted                                                 |
| `systems`                | `string[]`                                           | yes      |         |                                          | the system names in run order (systems are code, not saved)                            |
| `entities`               | `object[]`                                           | yes      |         |                                          | every live entity, ascending by id (terrain is the `Terrain` component of one of them) |
| `entities[].id`          | `integer`                                            | yes      |         | >= 1                                     | the entity id                                                                          |
| `entities[].components`  | `{ <key>: JSON }`                                    | yes      |         | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`  | the entity's components by name, each checked by that component's schema               |
| `log`                    | `object`                                             | yes      |         |                                          | the event log and its retention                                                        |
| `log.enabled`            | `boolean`                                            | yes      |         |                                          | false when the world records no log                                                    |
| `log.ticks`              | `integer \| null`                                    | yes      |         |                                          | keep only the last n committed ticks of changes; null keeps everything                 |
| `log.events`             | `object[]`                                           | yes      |         |                                          | the kept changes, oldest first                                                         |
| `log.events[].tick`      | `integer`                                            | yes      |         | >= 0                                     | the tick the change was made at                                                        |
| `log.events[].cause`     | `string`                                             | yes      |         | not empty                                | who made it: a system name, `external`, `order:<id>`, `scenario`, ...                  |
| `log.events[].op`        | `"spawn" \| "destroy" \| "add" \| "set" \| "remove"` | yes      |         |                                          | what it did                                                                            |
| `log.events[].entity`    | `integer`                                            | yes      |         | >= 1                                     | the entity changed                                                                     |
| `log.events[].component` | `string`                                             | no       |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`        | the component, for add, set and remove                                                 |
| `log.events[].before`    | `JSON`                                               | no       |         |                                          | the data before, for set and remove                                                    |
| `log.events[].value`     | `JSON`                                               | no       |         |                                          | the data after, for add and set                                                        |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/world-save.json`):

```json
{
  "format": "worlds-within/world",
  "version": 1,
  "seed": 7,
  "tick": 1,
  "nextId": 3,
  "rng": 7,
  "components": [
    "Construction",
    "Health",
    "Inventory",
    "Member",
    "Owner",
    "Patrol",
    "Position",
    "Squad",
    "Terrain",
    "Worker"
  ],
  "systems": ["heal"],
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "components": {
        "Terrain": {
          "width": 3,
          "height": 2,
          "types": [{ "name": "ground", "cost": 1, "passable": true }],
          "elevation": [0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 2],
          "cells": [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "components": {
        "Health": { "hp": 4, "max": 4 },
        "Inventory": { "wood": 2 },
        "Owner": { "faction": "village" },
        "Position": { "x": 1, "y": 1, "z": 0 }
      }
    }
  ],
  "log": {
    "enabled": true,
    "ticks": null,
    "events": [
      { "tick": 0, "cause": "scenario", "op": "spawn", "entity": 1 },
      {
        "tick": 0,
        "cause": "scenario",
        "op": "add",
        "entity": 1,
        "component": "Terrain",
        "value": {
          "width": 3,
          "height": 2,
          "types": [{ "name": "ground", "cost": 1, "passable": true }],
          "elevation": [0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 2],
          "cells": [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
        }
      },
      { "tick": 0, "cause": "scenario", "op": "spawn", "entity": 2 },
      {
        "tick": 0,
        "cause": "scenario",
        "op": "add",
        "entity": 2,
        "component": "Position",
        "value": { "x": 1, "y": 1, "z": 0 }
      },
      {
        "tick": 0,
        "cause": "scenario",
        "op": "add",
        "entity": 2,
        "component": "Health",
        "value": { "hp": 3, "max": 4 }
      },
      {
        "tick": 0,
        "cause": "scenario",
        "op": "add",
        "entity": 2,
        "component": "Owner",
        "value": { "faction": "village" }
      },
      {
        "tick": 0,
        "cause": "scenario",
        "op": "add",
        "entity": 2,
        "component": "Inventory",
        "value": { "wood": 2 }
      },
      {
        "tick": 0,
        "cause": "heal",
        "op": "set",
        "entity": 2,
        "component": "Health",
        "before": { "hp": 3, "max": 4 },
        "value": { "hp": 4, "max": 4 }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## World scenario (`worldFromScenario`)

A world written as data (Engine 0.8): the seed, the terrain as text grids of ground types and elevation digits, entities with their components, and squads with their named members.

- Defined by: engine/sim
- Where: wherever a game keeps its world starts (the engine's sample: `engine/sim/__fixtures__/village.world.json`); `worldFromScenario(json, options)` reads it
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                           | Type                               | Required | Default | Limits                                  | Description                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `format`                        | `"worlds-within/scenario"`         | yes      |         |                                         | always `worlds-within/scenario`                                                                                                                        |
| `version`                       | `1`                                | yes      |         |                                         | the scenario format version                                                                                                                            |
| `seed`                          | `integer`                          | yes      |         |                                         | the world's seed                                                                                                                                       |
| `systems`                       | `"village" \| "rts"`               | no       |         |                                         | the engine system set the world runs with: `village` (haul, build, patrol) or `rts` (the RTS units and economy); the tools use `village` when left out |
| `terrain`                       | `object`                           | yes      |         |                                         | the terrain grid                                                                                                                                       |
| `terrain.legend`                | `{ <key>: object }`                | yes      |         | keys: not empty; length &lt;= 1         | one ground type per grid character; types are numbered in sorted character order                                                                       |
| `terrain.legend.<key>.name`     | `string`                           | yes      |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`      | the ground type name                                                                                                                                   |
| `terrain.legend.<key>.cost`     | `integer`                          | yes      |         | >= 1                                    | ticks to enter a cell of this type                                                                                                                     |
| `terrain.legend.<key>.passable` | `boolean`                          | yes      |         |                                         | false: nothing can enter it                                                                                                                            |
| `terrain.rows`                  | `string[]`                         | yes      |         | at least 1 item; items: not empty       | the grid, one string per row, north first                                                                                                              |
| `terrain.elevation`             | `string[]`                         | yes      |         | items: matches `^[0-9]+$`               | one elevation digit (0-9) per cell, the same size as `rows`                                                                                            |
| `entities`                      | `object[]`                         | no       | `[]`    |                                         | entities, spawned in this order                                                                                                                        |
| `entities[].key`                | `string`                           | no       |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`      | a name other entities can `$ref`                                                                                                                       |
| `entities[].components`         | `{ <key>: JSON }`                  | yes      |         | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` | components by name, each checked by its schema; `{ "$ref": "<key>" }` is an entity id                                                                  |
| `squads`                        | `object[]`                         | no       | `[]`    |                                         | squads, each spawned after the entities                                                                                                                |
| `squads[].key`                  | `string`                           | no       |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`      | a name other entities can `$ref`                                                                                                                       |
| `squads[].strength`             | `integer`                          | no       |         | >= 0                                    | everyone in it; default: the named members                                                                                                             |
| `squads[].components`           | `{ <key>: JSON }`                  | no       | `{}`    | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` | the squad entity's other components (not `Squad`, which is built from this entry)                                                                      |
| `squads[].members`              | `object[]`                         | no       | `[]`    |                                         | the named people, spawned right after their squad                                                                                                      |
| `squads[].members[].key`        | `string`                           | no       |         | matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`      | a name other entities can `$ref`                                                                                                                       |
| `squads[].members[].name`       | `string`                           | yes      |         | not empty                               | the person's name                                                                                                                                      |
| `squads[].members[].role`       | `"regular" \| "hero" \| "captain"` | yes      |         |                                         | at most one captain per squad                                                                                                                          |
| `squads[].members[].components` | `{ <key>: JSON }`                  | no       | `{}`    | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` | other components (not `Member`)                                                                                                                        |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/world-scenario.json`):

```json
{
  "format": "worlds-within/scenario",
  "version": 1,
  "seed": 7,
  "terrain": {
    "legend": {
      ".": { "name": "grass", "cost": 1, "passable": true },
      "^": { "name": "hills", "cost": 2, "passable": true },
      "~": { "name": "river", "cost": 1, "passable": false }
    },
    "rows": ["..~..", "..~^^", "....^"],
    "elevation": ["11011", "11023", "11112"]
  },
  "entities": [
    { "key": "pile", "components": { "Position": { "x": 0, "y": 0, "z": 1 }, "Inventory": { "wood": 20 } } },
    {
      "key": "hut",
      "components": {
        "Position": { "x": 4, "y": 2, "z": 2 },
        "Construction": { "kind": "hut", "progress": 0, "work": 12, "done": false },
        "Health": { "hp": 1, "max": 50 }
      }
    },
    {
      "components": {
        "Position": { "x": 1, "y": 0, "z": 1 },
        "Worker": { "job": { "$ref": "hut" }, "rate": 2 },
        "Walk": { "wait": 0 },
        "Hauler": {
          "item": "wood",
          "source": { "$ref": "pile" },
          "capacity": 2,
          "carry": 0,
          "rest": 0,
          "restOdds": 30,
          "restTicks": 5
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "squads": [
    {
      "key": "watch",
      "strength": 6,
      "components": {
        "Position": { "x": 0, "y": 2, "z": 1 },
        "Walk": { "wait": 0 },
        "Patrol": {
          "waypoints": [
            { "x": 0, "y": 2, "z": 1 },
            { "x": 4, "y": 0, "z": 1 }
          ],
          "index": 1
        }
      },
      "members": [
        { "name": "Aldric", "role": "captain" },
        { "name": "Brenna", "role": "hero" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Content kinds

The engine defines some kinds and each kit adds its own (`engine/tools/kits.ts`); a game claims
files for each kind in `game.json`.

### RTS unit and building types (`rtsTypesSchema`)

The unit and building types an RTS world makes things from (Engine 0.9): stats, costs, build and training time, what a building trains and whether it takes drop-offs.

- Defined by: engine/core
- Where: a game's RTS data, held in the world by the `RtsTypes` component (in a world scenario: an entity's `RtsTypes`)
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                     | Type                 | Required | Default | Limits                                    | Description                                                                                                 |
| ------------------------- | -------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `units`                   | `{ <key>: object }`  | yes      |         | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`  | unit types by id                                                                                            |
| `units.<key>.health`      | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | hit points of a new unit (Health.max)                                                                       |
| `units.<key>.speed`       | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | ticks to cross one cell of cost 1 in a straight line                                                        |
| `units.<key>.attack`      | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 0                                      | damage per hit (0: it never hurts anything)                                                                 |
| `units.<key>.range`       | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | how far it hits, in whole cells                                                                             |
| `units.<key>.cooldown`    | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | ticks from one hit to the next                                                                              |
| `units.<key>.sight`       | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 0                                      | how far it sees, in whole cells (for the view)                                                              |
| `units.<key>.cost`        | `{ <key>: integer }` | no       | `{}`    | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`  | what one costs, paid from the faction stockpile: item id -> count                                           |
| `units.<key>.trainTicks`  | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | ticks a building takes to train one                                                                         |
| `units.<key>.work`        | `integer \| null`    | no       | `null`  |                                           | construction work it adds per tick; only units with it can build                                            |
| `units.<key>.gather`      | `object \| null`     | no       | `null`  |                                           | { capacity, ticks }: it carries at most capacity, one item every ticks ticks; only units with it can gather |
| `buildings`               | `{ <key>: object }`  | no       | `{}`    | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`  | building types by id                                                                                        |
| `buildings.<key>.health`  | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | hit points once built (Health.max)                                                                          |
| `buildings.<key>.size`    | `object`             | yes      |         |                                           | its footprint in cells, from its Position (the north-west cell)                                             |
| `buildings.<key>.size.w`  | `integer`            | yes      |         | 1 to 16                                   | width in cells, west to east                                                                                |
| `buildings.<key>.size.h`  | `integer`            | yes      |         | 1 to 16                                   | height in cells, north to south                                                                             |
| `buildings.<key>.work`    | `integer`            | yes      |         | >= 1                                      | construction work to finish it (build time: work / the workers' rates)                                      |
| `buildings.<key>.cost`    | `{ <key>: integer }` | no       | `{}`    | keys: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$`  | what one costs, paid from the faction stockpile: item id -> count                                           |
| `buildings.<key>.trains`  | `string[]`           | no       | `[]`    | items: matches `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$` | the unit types it can train, once finished                                                                  |
| `buildings.<key>.dropoff` | `boolean`            | no       | `false` |                                           | whether gatherers can drop resources here, once finished                                                    |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/rts-types.json`):

```json
{
  "units": {
    "worker": {
      "health": 20,
      "speed": 3,
      "attack": 1,
      "range": 1,
      "cooldown": 4,
      "sight": 5,
      "cost": { "gold": 50 },
      "trainTicks": 30,
      "work": 2,
      "gather": { "capacity": 5, "ticks": 4 }
    },
    "soldier": {
      "health": 40,
      "speed": 3,
      "attack": 5,
      "range": 1,
      "cooldown": 6,
      "sight": 6,
      "cost": { "gold": 60 },
      "trainTicks": 45
    }
  },
  "buildings": {
    "hall": { "health": 600, "size": { "w": 3, "h": 3 }, "work": 300, "trains": ["worker"], "dropoff": true },
    "barracks": {
      "health": 300,
      "size": { "w": 2, "h": 2 },
      "work": 120,
      "cost": { "gold": 100 },
      "trains": ["soldier"]
    }
  }
}
```

### `palette`

A named list of colours (#rgb or #rrggbb) that sprite indices pick from.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.palette`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field    | Type       | Required | Default | Limits                                                                | Description                                                                 |
| -------- | ---------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | `string`   | yes      |         | not empty                                                             | the palette name sprites give in `palette`                                  |
| `colors` | `string[]` | yes      |         | 1 to 36 items; items: matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | the colours, "#rgb" or "#rrggbb"; a sprite index picks one (0 is the first) |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/palette.json`):

```json
{ "id": "hero", "colors": ["#000000", "#00a800", "#fca044", "#fcfcfc"] }
```

### `sfx`

An MML sound effect: id, optional bpm and up to four voices.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.sfx`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field      | Type     | Required | Default | Limits          | Description                       |
| ---------- | -------- | -------- | ------- | --------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `id`       | `string` | yes      |         | not empty       | the sound id the game plays it by |
| `bpm`      | `number` | no       |         | &lt;= 1000; > 0 | tempo in beats per minute         |
| `pulse`    | `string` | no       |         |                 | the pulse channel's MML           |
| `pulse2`   | `string` | no       |         |                 | the second pulse channel's MML    |
| `triangle` | `string` | no       |         |                 | the triangle channel's MML        |
| `noise`    | `string` | no       |         |                 | the noise channel's MML           |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/sfx.json`):

```json
{ "id": "chime", "bpm": 240, "pulse": "v12 @1 l16 o5 c e g > c" }
```

### `skin`

How a backend shows a game: each kind as a sprite or mesh, tiles, event sounds and effects, the HUD.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.skin`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field                         | Type                                          | Required | Default | Limits                                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `backend`                     | `string`                                      | yes      |         | not empty                                       | the backend it is for: `canvas2d`, `three` (meshes) or another backend name                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `sheets`                      | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | defaults for entries that leave a field out                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `sheets.sheet`                | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | the sprite file for entries that name none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `sheets.palette`              | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | the palette for entries that name none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `sheets.fallbackColor`        | `string`                                      | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | the box colour for entries that give none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `kinds`                       | `{ <key>: object }`                           | yes      |         | keys: not empty                                 | entity kind -> how it looks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `kinds.<key>.sheet`           | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 2D: the sprite file the frames are in (default `sheets.sheet`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `kinds.<key>.palette`         | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 2D: a palette to draw with instead of the sprite's own                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `kinds.<key>.frames`          | `{ <key>: string \| object }`                 | no       |         | keys: not empty                                 | 2D: animation state -> a frame name, `{ frames, ticks?, loop? }` (a cycle) or `{ up?, down?, left?, right?, up-left?, up-right?, down-left?, down-right? }` (a frame or cycle per facing, all optional; a diagonal left out uses its horizontal part); `idle` is used for a state not listed |
| `kinds.<key>.flipFacing`      | `boolean`                                     | no       |         |                                                 | 2D: draw the right-hand frames mirrored when the entity faces left or a left-hand diagonal                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `kinds.<key>.size`            | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | 2D: the drawn size, when it is not the frame size                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `kinds.<key>.size.w`          | `integer`                                     | yes      |         | >= 1                                            | width in pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `kinds.<key>.size.h`          | `integer`                                     | yes      |         | >= 1                                            | height in pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `kinds.<key>.fallbackColor`   | `string`                                      | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | 2D: the box colour when a frame is missing (default `sheets.fallbackColor`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `kinds.<key>.mesh`            | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 3D: a primitive (`box`, `wedge`, `cylinder`, `cone`, `sphere`, `plane`) or a key of `meshes`                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `kinds.<key>.color`           | `string`                                      | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | 3D: the mesh's colour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `kinds.<key>.scale`           | `number`                                      | no       |         | > 0                                             | 3D: size factor about the box's bottom centre (default 1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `kinds.<key>.depth`           | `number`                                      | no       |         | > 0                                             | 3D: a primitive mesh's thickness in px (default: the box's width; a tile is one tile deep)                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `kinds.<key>.z`               | `number`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | 3D: px toward the camera from the depth plane (default 0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `kinds.<key>.offset`          | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | where the sprite or mesh sits from the entity box's top-left corner                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `kinds.<key>.offset.x`        | `integer`                                     | yes      |         |                                                 | pixels right                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `kinds.<key>.offset.y`        | `integer`                                     | yes      |         |                                                 | pixels down                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `tiles`                       | `{ <key>: object }`                           | no       |         | keys: not empty                                 | map tile character or id -> how it looks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `tiles.<key>.sheet`           | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 2D: the sprite file (default `sheets.sheet`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `tiles.<key>.frame`           | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 2D: the frame name in the sheet                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `tiles.<key>.fallbackColor`   | `string`                                      | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | 2D: the colour when the frame is missing (default `sheets.fallbackColor`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `tiles.<key>.mesh`            | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | 3D: a primitive (`box`, `wedge`, `cylinder`, `cone`, `sphere`, `plane`) or a key of `meshes`                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `tiles.<key>.color`           | `string`                                      | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | 3D: the mesh's colour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `tiles.<key>.depth`           | `number`                                      | no       |         | > 0                                             | 3D: a primitive mesh's thickness in px (default: the box's width; a tile is one tile deep)                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `tiles.<key>.z`               | `number`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | 3D: px toward the camera from the depth plane (default 0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `events`                      | `{ <key>: object }`                           | no       |         | keys: not empty                                 | event type -> its sound and effect                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `events.<key>.sound`          | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | a song or sfx id to play                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `events.<key>.effect`         | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | a presentation-only effect at the event                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `events.<key>.effect.kind`    | `"flash" \| "particles" \| "shake" \| "tint"` | yes      |         |                                                 | what the backend shows                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `events.<key>.effect.color`   | `string`                                      | no       |         | matches `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$` | its colour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `events.<key>.effect.ticks`   | `integer`                                     | no       |         | >= 1                                            | how long it lasts                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `events.<key>.effect.count`   | `integer`                                     | no       |         | >= 1                                            | particles: how many                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `events.<key>.effect.size`    | `number`                                      | no       |         | > 0                                             | particles: size in pixels; shake: strength                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `hud`                         | `object[]`                                    | no       |         |                                                 | status values drawn on screen, in order                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `hud[].status`                | `string`                                      | yes      |         | not empty                                       | the status key it shows (`health`, `score`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `hud[].as`                    | `"hearts" \| "number" \| "text" \| "icon"`    | yes      |         |                                                 | how it shows                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `hud[].x`                     | `integer`                                     | yes      |         |                                                 | left edge, screen pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `hud[].y`                     | `integer`                                     | yes      |         |                                                 | top edge, screen pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `hud[].sheet`                 | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | the sprite file for hearts and icons (default `sheets.sheet`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `hud[].frame`                 | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | the frame for hearts and icons                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `hud[].font`                  | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | the font for numbers and text                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `camera`                      | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | framing defaults; a frame's own camera hint wins                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `camera.zoom`                 | `number`                                      | no       |         | > 0                                             | scale factor (default 1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `camera.follow`               | `string`                                      | no       |         | not empty                                       | the entity kind or id to keep in view                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `camera.deadzone`             | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | a box round the screen centre the followed entity moves in freely                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `camera.deadzone.w`           | `integer`                                     | yes      |         | >= 0                                            | width in pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `camera.deadzone.h`           | `integer`                                     | yes      |         | >= 0                                            | height in pixels                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `camera.lerp`                 | `number`                                      | no       |         | 0 to 1                                          | how far the camera closes the gap each frame (1 snaps)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `camera.clamp`                | `boolean`                                     | no       |         |                                                 | keep the view inside the map, centring a smaller map (default true); false lets a camera hint place it                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `meshes`                      | `{ <key>: object[] }`                         | no       |         | keys: not empty                                 | 3D: named compound meshes, each a list of primitive parts in world px                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `camera3d`                    | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | 3D: perspective framing and light defaults                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `camera3d.fov`                | `number`                                      | no       |         | 1 to 179                                        | vertical field of view, degrees (default 45)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `camera3d.tilt`               | `number`                                      | no       |         | -45 to 45                                       | pitch, degrees; positive looks down a little (default 0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `camera3d.layerDepth`         | `number`                                      | no       |         | >= 0                                            | px toward the camera per entity `layer` (default 16)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `camera3d.lights`             | `object`                                      | no       |         |                                                 | kept minimal: ambient plus one directional light                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `camera3d.lights.ambient`     | `number`                                      | no       |         | >= 0                                            | ambient light intensity (default 0.6)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `camera3d.lights.directional` | `number`                                      | no       |         | >= 0                                            | the one directional light's intensity (default 0.8)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/skin.json`):

```json
{
  "backend": "canvas2d",
  "sheets": { "sheet": "hero", "palette": "hero", "fallbackColor": "#00a800" },
  "kinds": {
    "hero": {
      "frames": {
        "idle": { "down": "down-0", "up": "up-0", "right": "side-0" },
        "walk": {
          "down": { "frames": ["down-0", "down-1"], "ticks": 8 },
          "right": { "frames": ["side-0", "side-1"], "ticks": 8 }
        },
        "hurt": "hurt"
      },
      "flipFacing": true
    },
    "bat": {
      "sheet": "bat",
      "frames": { "fly": { "frames": ["a", "b"], "ticks": 6 } },
      "fallbackColor": "#a800a8"
    }
  },
  "tiles": { "#": { "sheet": "walls", "frame": "wall", "fallbackColor": "#7c7c7c" } },
  "events": {
    "hit": { "sound": "hurt", "effect": { "kind": "flash", "color": "#fcfcfc", "ticks": 4 } },
    "coin": { "sound": "coin" }
  },
  "hud": [
    { "status": "health", "as": "hearts", "x": 8, "y": 8, "sheet": "hud", "frame": "heart" },
    { "status": "score", "as": "number", "x": 200, "y": 8 }
  ],
  "camera": { "follow": "hero", "lerp": 0.25 }
}
```

### `song`

An MML song: id, bpm, loop and up to four channels.

- Defined by: engine
- Where: `content/`, claimed in `game.json` under `content.song`
- Read from: `.json`

| Field      | Type      | Required | Default | Limits          | Description                                             |
| ---------- | --------- | -------- | ------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | `string`  | yes      |         | not empty       | the song id rooms and scenes name it by                 |
| `bpm`      | `number`  | yes      |         | &lt;= 1000; > 0 | tempo in beats per minute                               |
| `loop`     | `boolean` | yes      |         |                 | start again at the `L` mark (or the start) when it ends |
| `pulse1`   | `string`  | no       |         |                 | the first pulse channel's MML                           |
| `pulse2`   | `string`  | no       |         |                 | the second pulse channel's MML                          |
| `triangle` | `string`  | no       |         |                 | the triangle channel's MML                              |
| `noise`    | `string`  | no       |         |                 | the noise channel's MML                                 |

Example (`docs/reference/examples/song.json`):

```json
{
  "id": "theme",
  "bpm": 120,
  "loop": true,
  "pulse1": "v10 @2 l8 o4 L [c e g > c < g e]2 d f a f",
  "triangle": "l4 o3 L [c g]2 d a"
}
```

### `sprite`

Text-grid pixel art: a palette name, an optional legend and named frames.

- Defined by: engine
